lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho₂Cu₈Ge₄ (reduced formula Ho(Cu₂Ge)₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, Ho centers with 20 neighbors (8 Cu, 12 Ge), and Ge centers with 9 neighbors (4 Cu, 5 Ho). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Cu 12-vertex and Ge 9-vertex polyhedra, edge-sharing between Cu polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ho 20-vertex polyhedra.
